notes: Bundled parser rules, authored against the corpus in parser/src/test/resources/corpus. This file is the single source of truth: :parser's accuracy harness measures it and the Gradle syncParserRules task copies it into app/src/main/assets, so the app runs exactly what the tests measure. Rules are data — adding a provider or an Amharic template is an edit here, not a code change.

rules.name: CBE — debit transaction with fee breakdown
rules.bodyPattern: A debit transaction of ETB\s*(?<amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)\.?\s*has occurred on your account.*?Your current balance is ETB\s*(?<balance>[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)
rules.notes: The amount is stated before the fees and differs from the 'total of ETB…' that follows it. Anchoring on the leading phrase avoids picking up the total.

rules.name: CBE — transfer out to a named account
rules.bodyPattern: You have successfully transferred ETB\s*(?<amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)\s+from account\s+\S+\s+to account\s+\S+\s*\((?<name>[^)]*)\).*?Your current balance is ETB\s*(?<balance>[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)

rules.name: CBE — received from a named account
rules.bodyPattern: You have received ETB\s*(?<amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)\s+from account\s+\S+\s*\((?<name>[^)]*)\)\s*to your account.*?Your current balance is ETB\s*(?<balance>[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)

rules.name: CBE — account credited by a named party
rules.bodyPattern: your Account\s+\S+\s+has been credited by\s+(?<name>.+?)\s+with ETB\s*(?<amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)\.?\s*Your Current Balance is ETB\s*(?<balance>[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)
rules.notes: Higher priority than the plain 'credited with' rule so the named-party form is preferred when both could apply.

rules.name: CBE — account credited with reference and in-body timestamp
rules.bodyPattern: your Account\s+\S+\s+has been Credited with ETB\s*(?<amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)\s+from\s+(?<name>.+?),\s*on\s+(?<timestamp>\d{1,2}/\d{1,2}/\d{2,4}\s+at\s+\d{1,2}:\d{2}:\d{2})\s+with Ref No\s+(?<ref>\S+)\s+Your Current Balance is ETB\s*(?<balance>[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)

rules.name: CBE — account credited, no counterparty stated
rules.bodyPattern: your Account\s+\S+\s+has been credited with ETB\s*(?<amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)\.?\s*Your Current Balance is ETB\s*(?<balance>[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)

rules.name: CBE — account debited with inline fees
rules.bodyPattern: your Account\s+\S+\s+has been debited with ETB\s*(?<amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)\s+including.*?Your Current Balance is ETB\s*(?<balance>[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)

rules.name: EBIRR — wallet send to a named counterparty
EBIRR — wallet receipt from a bank
EBIRR — transfer out to a bank account
rules.bodyPattern: Transfer ID:\s*(?<ref>\d+),\s*You have successfully transferred ETB\s*(?<amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)\s+Charges:.*?your balance is ETB\s*(?<balance>[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)
rules.notes: The counterparty parentheses are empty in this template, so no name is captured. The parser must return null rather than a blank string.

rules.name: EBIRR — airtime top-up received
rules.bodyPattern: Transfer ID:\s*(?<ref>\d+),\s*You have received airtime top-up of ETB\s*(?<amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)
rules.notes: No balance is stated. Slightly lower confidence because an airtime top-up is arguably not a ledger movement for a shop.

rules.name: telebirr — package purchase
rules.bodyPattern: You have paid ETB\s*(?<amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)\s+for package\s+.*?purchase made for\s+(?<phone>\d+)\s+on\s+(?<timestamp>\d{1,2}/\d{1,2}/\d{4}\s+\d{1,2}:\d{2}:\d{2})\.\s*Your transaction number is\s+(?<ref>[A-Za-z0-9]+)\.\s*Your current balance is ETB\s*(?<balance>[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)

rules.name: telebirr — received from a bank
rules.bodyPattern: You have received ETB\s*(?<amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)\s+by transaction number\s+(?<ref>[A-Za-z0-9]+)\s+on\s+(?<timestamp>\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}\s+\d{1,2}:\d{2}:\d{2})\s+from\s+(?<name>.+?)\s+to your telebirr Account.*?Your current balance is ETB\s*(?<balance>[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)

rules.name: telebirr — airtime top-up recharge
rules.bodyPattern: You have received airtime top up recharge ETB\s*(?<amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)\s+from\s+.*?\s+on\s+(?<timestamp>\d{1,2}/\d{1,2}/\d{4}\s+\d{1,2}:\d{2}:\d{2})\s*\.?\s*Your transaction number is\s+(?<ref>[A-Za-z0-9]+)
